title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence:
form_fields.autocomplete_for("guarantor_name") |> should.equal("name")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("guarantor_phone") |> should.equal("tel")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("guarantor_email") |> should.equal("email")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[0][employer_ref_phone]")
  |> should.equal("tel-national")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("additional_income[1][note]")

detail: Pure SSR attribute-mapping change; no DB/HTTP/auth paths. Every behavior change has a pin: mapping, bracket normalization, tel/tel-national split, HTML render, whitelist, 'off' fallback. P0=100%, P1=100%, overall~100%.
recommended_fix: No change needed; gate passes. Optional: add a negative pin that view_select_field/view_textarea_field emit no autocomplete attr to guard the spec's 'Never' boundary (not a regression risk; those fns are untouched).
